links.outcome: Deferral of cases to manual review via predefined safety criteria; accuracy of automated cases
links.effect: Colon-Pilot issued recommendations for 522 of 596 cases (87.6%) and flagged 12.4% for manual review. For automated cases, guideline-concordant accuracy was 97.5% (Cohen κ = 0.970) versus 69.7% for endoscopists.

links.outcome: Guideline-concordant surveillance accuracy of AI versus original endoscopist recommendations

screen.reason: The study evaluates Colon-Pilot (GPT-4o) for surveillance recommendations and administrative quality audit, incorporating and directly testing safety criteria that route complex/high-risk cases to manual human review.

primary.practice: predefined safety criteria triggering manual review / triage
